Author: D.Ramesh

 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.6522 of 2021
Order:

This Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed seeking quash of the proceedings in Crime No.28 of 2020 on the file of the Nagarjuna Sagar Police Station,
Guntur District against the petitioner/Accused No.10.
2.

entities.text:
Nagarjuna Sagar Police Station,
Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that this petitioner cover matter and this Court earlier quashed the F.I.Rs and charge sheets registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, he would submit that the petitioner, who is similarly placed, is also entitled for quash of the proceedings in the above said crime registered against him.

4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would fairly concede that this petition is covered matter in view of the earlier orders of this Court and thereby prayed to pass appropriate orders accordingly.

5. As can be seen from the copy of the common order produced by the petitioner in Criminal Petition No.1432 of 2020 and batch, it is clear that this Court has quashed the F.I.Rs registered in various police stations for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328, 353, 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, under Sections 56, 57(1), 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 24 (1) r/w 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003.
6.
